English: Pay on time, get it on time.
Hm? The recipe for Peat? Confidential.
Hungry? Have some Davre ramen. Just add water. Water? Of course you buy that from us too.
Chinese: 饿了就吃达夫雷拉面，加水即可食用。水？当然也找我们买。

English: Every time Security hands out rations, we get the most orders. So many the factory's about to burst.
Chinese: 每次治安部发放口粮，我们的单子总是最多，多到工厂都要炸了。

English: Doreen. (sets down a can of Peat)
I'm Davre Food's supply rep for the Lower Levels. Davre Food—cheap and filling.
Chinese: 我是达夫雷食品的下层区供应专员。达夫雷食品，便宜管饱。

English: Using a HydraTech purifier, I see. Don't throw it away when it wears out—I'll buy it back.
Chinese: 在用海德拉净水器啊。用旧了别扔，找我回收。

English: presses a business card onto the counter
We're buying HydraTech purifiers in bulk. New or used.
Chinese: 我们在大批量收海德拉净水器，新旧都要。

English: R&D wants to take them apart.
This is the Leviathan. A Davre product.
Chinese: 这东西叫利维坦。达夫雷的产品。

English: It might not filter quite as well as a HydraTech, but it handles Rustwater and Ghostwater.
Chinese: 渗透度可能比海德拉差点，但铁锈水、幽灵水都能过滤。

English: And it lasts longer than a HydraTech.
One per week. Just call to order.
Chinese: 每周限订一台，打电话就行。

English: How much water there is doesn't really matter. What matters is who controls the purification process.
Chinese: 其实水多水少并不重要，谁掌握净化工艺才重要。

English: Pastel is looking to move into food, so HQ has decided to secure the market first.
Chinese: 帕斯泰尔要往食品这块伸手，总部决定先占住市场。

English: They've approved a batch of equipment specifically for small shops like yours.
Chinese: 他们批了一批设备，专门下发给你这种小店。

English: One grinder, one canner. Pay the {0}₵ handling fee and they're yours. You'll have to find your own raw materials.
Chinese: 一台绞肉机，一台罐装机。手续费{0}₵，机器就归你。原料得你自己找。

English: If a machine breaks or you need another one, just call.
Chinese: 以后机器坏了或者要添新的，直接打电话。

English: The slots won't wait. Call when you've made up your mind. The fee stays the same.
Chinese: 名额可不等人。想好了就打电话，手续费不变。

English: Leviathan worn out? Don't worry, it's mass-produced.
Chinese: 利维坦用完了？别担心，这是量产品。

English: Remember, this visit does not constitute medical advice. (in an official tone)
Chinese: 记住，本次拜访不构成任何医疗建议（官方腔调）。

English: Up in the Upper Levels, ZeroChew goes by a different name: “Slim-X”. Same drug, but the price would buy you a whole box of ZeroChew.
Chinese: 零嚼在上层改了个名字，叫「纤体-X」。药还是同一种，但价格能买一整箱零嚼。

English: Immunivax, one shot every week. Such a steady stream of repeat customers. (sarcastically)
Chinese: 免疫宁每周都需要一针，回头客真是稳定呢（讽刺意味）。

English: The first three digits of the serial number identify the batch. The recalled batches are listed in the manual. Remember to check against it.
Chinese: 序列号的前三位是批次。手册上有写需要召回的批次，记得对比一下。

English: Oxymore is perfectly legal, you know. All the paperwork is in order.
Chinese: 奥克西莫可是合法药品，手续齐全。

English: Some say Sentinel Collapse was engineered. The company has no comment. (in an official tone)
Chinese: 有人说哨兵崩溃是人为设计的，公司对此不予置评（官方腔调）。

English: Carmicheal holds the patent for Phagimycin, yet most people have absolutely no idea.
Chinese: 噬菌霉素的专利在卡迈克尔手里，可大部分人居然毫不知情。

English: Isa Langdon, Market Compliance Officer, Carmicheal Pharmaceutical.
Chinese: 伊莎·兰登，卡迈克尔制药，市场规范部专员。

English: We make most of the medicine you'll come across. Immunivax in particular—a masterpiece of pharmaceutical chemistry.
Chinese: 你能见到的药大部分都是我们在生产。尤其是免疫宁，医药化工的杰作。

English: But the recent flood of copies has been cutting into genuine sales. Some shoddy counterfeits have even killed potential customers.
Chinese: 不过最近的大量仿制品已经冲击了正品售卖，劣质假药还害死了一些潜在买家。

English: For this to happen while the patent is still in effect... The higher-ups are very displeased. (frowns slightly)
Chinese: 专利期内发生这种事，公司高层非常不快。（微微蹙眉）

English: I hope you can help us take some of these copies off the market.
Chinese: 希望你能帮我们回收一些仿制品。

English: Hello. (hands over a list) A recall notice. We're recalling the batches listed here.
Chinese: 你好，（递过一张单子），召回通知，回收单子上列出的批次。

English: Also, you've been authorized to resell. Here's this period's allocation.
Chinese: 还有，你获得了外售权限。这是本期的。

English: There's actually nothing wrong with this batch. That idiot of a trade manager just priced it too low.
Chinese: 其实这批次的药没什么问题。就是外贸部经理那个糊涂蛋把价格定低了。

English: Oxymore sales in the Lower Levels are up forty percent this quarter.
Chinese: 下层区这个季度的奥克西莫销量涨了四成。

English: Naloxgone is up forty percent too.
Oh, sorry. Let's get back to business.
Chinese: 哦，对不起。我们继续谈生意。

English: I hear you have Synaprest? That addiction treatment from pastel.
Chinese: 听说你这里有赛纳普斯？就是帕斯泰尔的那种戒瘾药。

English: The R&D people insist on taking it apart, so they've asked me to buy some.
Chinese: 研发部那帮人非要拆开看看，要我收购一些。

English: We'd like to get into the addiction treatment business too.
Chinese: 我们也想做戒瘾的生意。

English: Don't mention this to anyone at pastel.
Uh, boss, it's Synaprest I'm after.
Chinese: 呃，店长，我要的是赛纳普斯。

English: I hear the specimen is here with you? Oh, what a headache. (puts a hand to her forehead)
Chinese: 听说收容物在你这里？诶，真让我头疼。（扶额）

English: Even the company's breeding program is only through its initial phase. How have you managed to raise it so well?
Chinese: 就连公司的繁殖计划都才初步完成诶，你怎么能养得这么好。

English: sets down a document and a blood drawer
Chinese: 放下文件和一支采血器

English: All right, I got you a breeding license. Next time you want to keep an unknown creature like this, please check with me first.
Chinese: 好吧，我帮你申请了养殖许可。以后要养这种未知生物，请先跟我确认一下。

English: Of course, we'll buy whatever the trilobites produce too. Though I don't even know what that is yet.
Chinese: 当然，三叶蜥的产物我们也会回收。虽然我现在连产什么都不知道。

English: Have you drawn its blood yet? R&D needs some raw materials.
Chinese: 你采过血了没？研发部需要一些原料。

English: A reactor. As long as the purity is high enough, it can make medicine.
Chinese: 反应釜，只要纯度够就能制药。

English: This one's free. If it breaks, though, you'll have to order another at full price.
Chinese: 这台不收钱，以后坏了可就要按原价订了哦。

English: Here, a Stamina Booster. A new product, not on the market yet. We need a few test subjects first.
Chinese: 喏，体力增强剂。新产品，目前还没上市，需要先找几个实验人员。

English: It permanently improves your constitution. Every dose needs an application and a lengthy approval process. Make it count, test subject.
Chinese: 能永久改善体质，每一支都要申请，还要走很长的审批流程。你要珍惜哦，实验员。

English: This one's for this period. Give me a call when you need more.
Chinese: 这是本期的，以后要用给我打电话。

English: closes the folder, reminds you quietly
The Lower Levels will come under my jurisdiction next quarter. Do remember to apply regularly, all right? This is good stuff.
Chinese: 下个季度，下层区会划拨到我的管辖范围。一定要记得定期申请哦，这可是好东西。

English: R&D took apart a lot of Synaprest. They were trying to make an addiction treatment, but there were too many unknown compounds. All they managed was a painkiller.
Chinese: 研发部拆了很多赛纳普斯。本来想做戒瘾药的，但是未知成分太多了，只做出来了镇痛剂。

English: Remember to apply for your Stamina Boosters on time.
Chinese: 记得按时申请体力增强剂。
卡迈克尔市场规范部，例行走访。

English: Channel inspection. Just a few minutes.
Brought you some hardware—the Nestfire and the Liberator. Locally made, all by hand.
Chinese: 我给你带了些家伙什——巢火和解放者，本地产，纯手搓。

English: leaves a note on the counter
Most of the cargo at the docks passes through our hands. Need anything, call this number.
Chinese: 码头的货大半都得过我们的手，有事打这个。

English: I've heard people recommending your shop lately.
Chinese: 最近听到有别人在推荐你这里。

English: Things have been getting worse lately.
Remember? The Black Market, the Revolution and the Lower Levels stand as one.
Chinese: 记得么？黑市、革命军、下层区是一个整体。

English: If you're in danger, call for help right away. We'll help you.
Chinese: 遇到危险立刻求援，我们会帮你。

English: Nutrifruit doesn't produce seeds. That way, once you've eaten it, you have to buy more from us.
Chinese: 营养果不产籽，这样吃完了还得找我们买。

English: Galaxy Blend is the healthiest. It's just that nobody likes it.
Chinese: 繁星果糊是最健康的，就是没人爱吃。

English: 4 In 1 Wash. Hair, body, teeth, laundry. Does it all.
Chinese: 四合一，洗头沐浴刷牙洗衣都用它。

English: PAX doesn't sell too well in the Lower Levels. Too expensive.
Chinese: 帕克斯在下层卖不太动。太贵了。

English: The Kotton fiber we make can even stop small-caliber pistol rounds.
Chinese: 我们公司产的韧棉纤维甚至能挡住小口径手枪弹。

English: Hi! I'm Milo, pastel Inc.'s sales rep for the Lower Levels.
Chinese: 你好！我是米洛，帕斯泰尔公司的下层区推销员。

English: pastel supplies nearly all the everyday goods in the Lower Levels.
Chinese: 帕斯泰尔几乎包揽了整个下层区的民生用品。

English: Uh, except Davre's share. Ha ha.
Chinese: 呃，达夫雷那片不算，哈哈。

English: Long time no see! It's me again, Milo!
pastel's announced a new subsidy policy. These are yours, free of charge.
Chinese: 帕斯泰尔公布了新的补贴政策。这几件送你了。

English: The higher-ups know full well: keep us “troublemakers” comfortable, and we won't cause trouble.
Chinese: 上面清楚得很，日子舒坦了，我们这些“刁民”才不会闹事。

English: Don't tell anyone I said that.
Chinese: 别跟别人讲我这么说过。

English: Hey! I got transferred to the Hemingway division.
Chinese: 嘿！我被调去海明威分部了。

English: I'm in charge of market security. Got fake cigarettes? Bring them out. I'll pay extra.
Chinese: 负责市场安全。有假烟就拿出来，我加价收。

English: I'm in charge of market security. Got fake cigarettes? Bring them out. I'll pay extra.
Chinese: 负责市场安全。有假烟就拿出来，我加价收。

English: I brought the real stuff too. Want some? Twenty percent off for you.
Chinese: 正品我也带了，想来点吗？给你打八折。

English: Honestly, I know there are more fake cigarettes on the market than real ones these days.
Chinese: 其实我知道，现在市场上的假烟比真的还多。

English: Thanks to you, business in the Lower Levels has been going well lately. I got promoted!
Chinese: 托你的福，近期的下层区业务开展得不错，我升职了！
正品，不要钱，算我请你的。

English: This is a label stamp the division uses for Limited Edition packaging. I slipped one out.
Chinese: 这是分部印限量包装的标签戳，我顺了一个出来。

English: One stamp does eight packs. Four hundred. You can't get these outside.
Chinese: 一个标签戳能印八包。四百块——外面买不到的。

English: Call me anytime if you want more. I've got an inside source. Two per period, max.
Chinese: 以后要的话随时打电话找我。内部渠道，一期最多两个。

English: Oh, tobacco is our main business, of course.
Chinese: 哦，烟草当然是我们的主营业务。

English: But we actually sell the shots that help you quit, too. (shrugs)
Chinese: 但其实我们也在卖戒瘾针（耸肩）。

English: The division is clearing out some old machines. Says the model's been retired.
Chinese: 分部要处理一批旧机器，说是型号淘汰了。

English: So before they go to the scrapyard, I wanted to ask you.
Chinese: 所以在拉去回收站之前，我想先问问你。

English: With this cigarette roller, you can make your own loose cigarettes. (quietly) I'll get you the seeds.
Chinese: 有了这台卷烟机，你就能自己做散烟。（小声）我会给你提供种子。

English: All right, I'll bring it in. A pack of seeds for you, too. Don't say it came from the company.
Chinese: 好，这就给你搬进来，种子也给你一包。别说是公司的。

English: That's a shame. Give me a call if you ever change your mind.
Chinese: 真可惜。哪天要是改主意了，打我电话。

English: Boss, I'm afraid our cigarette business might be finished.
Chinese: 店长，我们的香烟生意怕是要黄了。

English: The higher-ups have traced it back to me.
But I know the supervisor for this area. {0} credits, and it's like none of this ever happened.
Chinese: 不过，我认识这片的主管。{0}块，这事就当没发生。

English: There's a condition, though. Your cigarettes will have to go in Hemingway boxes from now on, too.
Chinese: 不过有条件，之后你的烟也得装进海明威的盒子里。

English: All right. I've brought you a packaging machine. From now on, what you make is genuine.
Chinese: 行。分装机我给你带来了，从今往后，你做的就是正品。

English: Don't take too long. Give me a call when you've decided.
Chinese: 别拖太久。想好了给我打电话。

English: Yes, yes, there are more fake Hemingways than real ones.
Chinese: 是，是，海明威的假烟比真的还多。

English: Standard live rounds require a Class I ammunition sales permit.
Chinese: 普通实弹需要一级售卖许可。

English: Armor-piercing rounds require a Class II ammunition sales permit.
Chinese: 穿甲弹需要二级售卖许可。

English: Requires a Class II firearm sales permit.
Chinese: 需要二级枪械售卖许可。

English: Requires a Class III firearm sales permit.
Chinese: 需要三级枪械售卖许可。

English: Rubber rounds are over the counter. Live rounds need Class I. Armor-piercing needs Class II.
Chinese: 橡胶弹不用证。普通实弹看一级，穿甲弹看二级。

English: The Sentinel Mk. III doesn't jam. At least, that's what the ads say.
Chinese: 哨兵3型不会卡壳。至少宣传上是这样。

English: Nobody uses more of those rubber-tipped rounds than Security. Looks a little better on the reports.
Chinese: 就属治安部用那些橡胶头的软弹最多。报告上写着好看一点。

English: AP rounds cost more. Buy them if you need them.
Chinese: 穿甲弹贵一点。真用得上再买。

English: Back to the factory once a year for maintenance.
Chinese: 每年都得回厂保养一次。

English: This scar? A drill. Who knew they were using live rounds?
Chinese: 这道疤？演习。谁知道演习上的是实弹。

English: Meridian never sells to the Black Market. We just lose a little more stock on the job.
Chinese: 子午线可从来不卖给黑市，我们的活计只是损耗大了一点。

English: takes out a Sentinel Mk. III to show you
Chinese: 拿出一把哨兵3型给你看

English: Just here to look around and check what you're cleared to sell. Looks good so far. I brought a couple of boxes of rubber rounds. No permit needed for those. Interested?
Chinese: 今天就是过来看看，确认一下你这边的资格。看着还不错。我带了几盒橡胶弹，这个不用证。要吗？

English: The Peacemaker. Standard issue. Show me the permit if you want one.
Chinese: 和平使者，标准军备。枪要按证卖。

English: (points at the scar on his left cheek) Most of my scars came from one of these.
Chinese: （指了指左脸那道疤）我身上绝大部分疤痕都是它留下的。

English: So I know just how well it works.
Chinese: 所以，我知道它有多好用。

English: Hey. (pulls out a big gun, sending the bystanders scrambling back)
Chinese: 嘿。（掏出一把大枪，旁人连忙退开）

English: The Rampart, a dual-action shotgun! One boom and it's all over.
Chinese: 「壁垒」，双动式霰弹枪！嘭的一声一切就都结束了。

English: The line can turn out hundreds a day. Every last one looks the same.
Chinese: 产线一天能出几百把，每把都一模一样。

English: It does make repairs a lot easier, I'll give it that.
Chinese: 当然，我承认这使维修方便很多。

English: You know, every gun the company makes has a serial number.
Chinese: 你知道吗，公司的每一把枪都有编号。

English: These two clearly don't. A revolver and a hunting rifle. Made them myself, all by hand.
Chinese: 而这两把显然没有。左轮，猎枪，我自己做的，纯手工打造。

English: Security doesn't deserve them. I trust you'll find someone who does.
Chinese: 治安部配不上它们。我相信你能找到配得上的人。

English: runs a hand over the wooden case
You'll need the right sales permit for the guns I brought today. For now, just have a look.
Chinese: 今天带来的枪得有对应的售卖许可才能卖。你先看看就行。

English: sets a steel billet on the counter
Chinese: 把一块钢坯放在柜台上

English: Stick a high-purity ingot in the forge overnight and this is what comes out.
Chinese: 把高纯度的金属锭塞进炉子里烧一夜，出来的就是这个。

English: I bought one kit too many by mistake… uh, I mean, I'm passing on the craft.
Chinese: 我不小心买多了一套…呃不是，我在传播这门手艺。

English: The whole kit's yours for {0}₵. I'll throw in three steel billets. Plenty to practice with.
Chinese: 整套家伙只要{0}₵，还送你三块钢坯，练手足够用了。

English: That's the spirit! If the forge breaks, you can order a new one from me.
Chinese: 好样的！炉子坏了找我订新的。

English: Call me when you've made up your mind.
I'll bring it by next week. I make these by hand. Can't rush it.
Chinese: 下周给你带来。手工制作，快不了。

English: A spritz of SYNC, and it'll open your customers' wallets for you.
Chinese: 喷一点「同步」，它会帮你打开顾客的钱包。

English: There's only one true luxury house in the entire galaxy.
Chinese: 全星系只有一家真正的奢侈品公司。

English: People down here can't afford these, and they have no use for them.
Chinese: 下层人用不起这些，也用不着。

English: Most of those innovative cosmetics at the tech expo come from Solana's downstream labs.
Chinese: 科技展上那些新锐的化妆品，大半都是索拉纳的下游实验室产的。

English: I never ask about the lab.
Chinese: 我从不过问实验室的事。

English: slaps down a business card and gives you a sidelong glance, eyes narrowed
Seline. Brand consultant and marketing specialist at Solana Biogenics.
Chinese: 瑟琳，索拉纳生物品牌顾问与市场专员。

English: “ETERNAL”, “SYNC”, “L'ESSENCE”… Do I really need to go on?
Chinese: 「永恒」、「同步」、「本源」……还用我继续介绍吗？

English: We don't usually do business in the Lower Levels. But someone recommended you, saying you have a little potential. (scoffs)
Chinese: 我们一般不在下层做生意，只是有人推荐说你有点潜力。（轻哼）

English: We're doing market research, so we're buying a batch of luxury goods to see what the competition is selling.
Chinese: 我们在做市场调研，所以要收购一批奢侈品，看看别家在卖什么。

English: I'll pay according to our purchasing standards. Nothing second-rate. Don't bother bringing out Solana's own products either.
Chinese: 我会按采购标准付钱，不要次品。索拉纳自家的也不必拿出来了。

English: Save all the finest pieces for me from now on.
Don't try to fool me—luxury goods only!
These are rare even in the Upper Levels, but I thought you could use them. (opens a box)
Chinese: 这些可在上层都是稀罕物，不过我猜你用得上。（打开盒子）

English: Don't get the wrong idea. I'm just passing by.

The Leviathan can't handle Gutterflow.
It only purifies Rustwater and Ghostwater.
Chinese:
利维坦对付不了沟渠水。
只能净化铁锈水和幽灵水。

English:
You put on the Socialite Essence.
Reputation gained from trades +50% for 3 days.
Chinese:
你抹上了名流精华。
3 天内交易得到的声望 +50%。

English:
You light the Solana Scented Candle.
Upper Levels customers' budget +15% for 3 days.
Chinese:
你点燃了索拉纳香薰蜡烛。
3 天内上层区顾客的预算 +15%。

English:
You inject the Stamina Booster, but your body has adapted.
Scavenging attempts are capped at +{0}; this shot adds nothing more (Service strength is set to Vanilla).
Chinese:
你注射了体力增强剂，但身体已经适应了。
拾荒次数上限最多 +{0}，这一针没有再增加（设置“服务强度”为原版）。

English:
You inject the Stamina Booster.
Daily scavenging attempts in the Dumping Grounds +1 ({0} injected so far).
Chinese:
你注射了体力增强剂。
每天在垃圾场的拾荒次数上限 +1（已注射 {0} 针）。

English:
You inject the Pain Blocker.
Your chance of getting hurt while scavenging is halved today.
Chinese:
你注射了痛觉屏蔽剂。
今天拾荒受伤的几率减半。

English:
You apply the Hemingway Quit Patch.
No nicotine withdrawal trading penalty for 3 days.
Chinese:
你贴上了海明威戒烟贴。
3 天内不受尼古丁戒断的交易惩罚。

English:
You put on the Night Repair Mask.
After your next night out, you won't open late the next day.
Chinese:
你敷上了夜间修护面膜。
下一次夜间外出，第二天不会开店迟到。

English: No room in the shop. Make some space first.
Chinese: 店里放不下了，先腾点地方再拆。

English: You split the isomer repair gel into 3 small tubes of isomer solution. Their purity varies; check them with a chemical scanner.
Chinese: 你拆开了异构修复凝胶，得到 3 小管异构蛋白溶液。纯度各不相同，可以用原版的化学检测仪看。

English: Your Pastel or Carmicheal subscription lapsed. Zacchaeus now wants {0}₵ a week for {1} weeks.
Chinese: 帕斯泰尔或卡迈克尔的订阅断了。撒该要求你每周还 {0}₵，共 {1} 周。

English: The gift missed its deadline. For the next {0} days, the corporations charge {1:0}% of each catalog sale as a channel fee.
Chinese: 礼物逾期未送达。接下来 {0} 天，卖出巨企目录商品时按成交额的 {1:0}% 计提渠道费。

English: Yesterday's gift went off in a Resistance safehouse. The Resistance struck back at you; Security stopped them, but the damage is done: fewer customers will come for a few days.
Chinese: 昨天那颗礼物在反抗军的据点爆炸。反抗军开始对你进行报复虽然被治安部拦下，但还是造成了影响：这几天来的顾客少了。

English: The Mentor left word: call him back (Merchant Union).
Chinese: 导师留了话，让你回个电话（商人联合）。

English: Good day. I'm Zacchaeus Thorne, director of the Joint District Administration.
Chinese: 您好。我是撒该·索恩，联合站区管理处站长。

English: We've noticed business has been good lately. Surely you could use a grant to expand.
Chinese: 我们注意到您的生意最近不错，想必很需要一笔扶持金来扩大规模。

English: The Administration can offer a {0}₵ grant, and you needn't even repay it. One simple condition: keep Pastel and Carmicheal's ordering services subscribed for three weeks straight. My friends are looking to expand their market.
Chinese: 管理处可以提供一笔 {0}₵ 扶持金，甚至不用您偿还。条件很简单：连续三周订阅帕斯泰尔和卡迈克尔的订购服务，我的朋友们最近需要扩大市场。

English: Wise. The money is on your counter.
Chinese: 明智。钱已经放在柜台上了。

English: A pity. Prices in the district may become somewhat volatile.
Chinese: 可惜。站区的物价最近恐怕会有些波动。

English: Three weeks, not a day missed. The Administration appreciates someone who keeps their word.
Chinese: 三周，一天不落。联合管理处很满意您信守承诺。

English: Please accept this medal. Display it somewhere visible; Upper Levels clients will notice.
Chinese: 这枚奖牌请收下。摆在显眼的地方，上层区的客人会注意到。

English: Business is thriving. The Administration has quietly been providing your shop with services you never see. I think a gesture of thanks is in order.
Chinese: 生意兴隆。管理处其实一直在为您的店铺提供看不见的服务，我觉得您需要做出一些表示。

English: Or... you could do us a small favor. There's a package that needs to reach a man named Odin. I know you two are well acquainted.
Chinese: 或者……您可以帮我们一个小忙。有一件东西，需要送到一位叫奥丁的人手里，我当然知道您和他很熟。

English: Once you receive the gift, you have two weeks. Book Odin through the Resistance phone and sell it to him. Do this, and I believe I can waive your subscription fees.
Chinese: 拿到礼物后，您有两周。通过反抗军电话预约奥丁，再把礼物卖给他。办成了，订购服务的订阅费我想我可以帮您免去。

English: Then the corporate ordering channel may be closed to you for a while. Do call me when you've reconsidered.
Chinese: 那么巨企的订货通道，暂时可能就不对您开放了。当然想通了打我电话。

English: I'm here to settle the channel fees accrued so far. I'll leave enough for any rent you still owe.
Chinese: 我来结算目前已记的渠道费。未交的房租会给您留出来。

English: Relax. I'm not here to settle scores.
Chinese: 别紧张。我不是来算账的。

English: I know who gave you that bomb. I also know you were forced.
Chinese: 我知道那颗炸弹是谁给你的。我也知道你是被逼的。

English: Everyone down here is the same. Their noose around every neck.
Chinese: 下层区的人都一样，脖子上都套着他们的绳子。

English: Congratulations on buying the shop. As of today, it's truly yours.
Chinese: 恭喜您买下了这间店。从今天起，您是这家店真正的店主了。

English: But an owner naturally belongs on the Administration's side, and we'll secure new benefits for you: 10% off orders, a weekly supply subsidy, and we'll even have a word with Security so they won't look too closely at what you've done.
Chinese: 不过店主理所应当的应该和管理处站在一方我们会为您争取新的利益：订货九折，每周一份物资补贴，甚至治安部那边我们也替您打招呼，不会过分追究您做了什么。

English: Naturally, you'd cut ties with those rats.
Chinese: 当然，您得和那些老鼠断干净。

English: They say you're one of the chosen.
Chinese: 他们说，你是被选中的人。

English: Not enough cash: this installment is missed.
You missed Zacchaeus's payment. All company services are suspended (except the Resistance), and he's started “visiting” your customers. Call him to agree to a repayment plan.
Chinese: 你没交上撒该的钱。所有公司服务暂停（反抗军除外），撒该开始“问候”你的客人。打他的电话可以答应还款计划。

English: Missed: pushed back a week. Corporate order prices are now +{0}% until you finish paying.
Chinese: 这期没交，顺延一周。巨企订货价格累计 +{0}%，还完恢复。

English: Zacchaeus has been paid in full.
There is no aid balance due.
Chinese: 现在没有待还的扶持金。

English: Finish the repayment conversation at the counter first.
Chinese: 请先结束柜台上的还款对话。

English: The gift cannot be claimed right now.
Inventory could not be checked. You can claim the gift later.
Chinese: 暂时无法核对库存，礼物仍可稍后领取。

English: The gift could not be placed. Make room in the shop and call Zacchaeus to claim it.
Chinese: 礼物暂未入库。请留出库存空间，再打撒该的电话领取。

English: Deliver only to Odin booked through the Resistance phone to collect this gift.
Chinese: 只能交给通过反抗军电话预约来收礼物的奥丁。

English: Zacchaeus's gift was not found in the shop. Call him to claim it and start the timer once it is placed.
Chinese: 店里未找到撒该的礼物。请打他的电话重新领取，入库后才开始计时。

English: The gift was delivered. Zacchaeus says corporate ordering services are now subscription-free.
Chinese: 礼物送到了。撒该说，巨企的订购服务以后不收订阅费了。

English: Odin cannot be booked, or cannot arrive before the deadline.
Chinese: 现在无法预约奥丁，或已来不及在期限内到达。

English: Channel fees for this collection: {0}₵ due, {1}₵ collected.
You've joined the corporations. The Resistance, disappointed, has cut ties with you.
Chinese: 你加入了巨企。反抗军很失望断了和你的联系。

English: Each to their own. The Resistance is back in touch, but no longer sends you underground buyers.
Chinese: 各办各事。反抗军恢复了联系，但不再给你安排地下买家。

English: Are you content to be the corporations' gatekeeper?
Chinese: 你甘心做巨企的看门人吗？

English: I understand. I'll make contact for you.
Chinese: 我明白了。我去替你联络。

English: You are now the corporations' agent for the Lower Levels: all company services are free, and orders are 20% off.
Chinese: 你成了下层区的巨企代理人：所有公司服务免费，订货八折。

English: (Test) Just passing by to see your shop.
Zacchaeus's number ({0}) is now in the notebook by the phone.
Chinese: 撒该的电话（{0}）记在了电话旁的记事簿上。

English: Joint District Administration. How can I help?
Chinese: 您好，这里是联合站区管理处。

English: You can only renew one week ahead.
Zacchaeus's penalty: all company services are suspended. Call him to agree to a repayment plan.
Chinese: 撒该的惩罚：所有公司服务暂停。打他的电话答应还款计划。

English: You turned Zacchaeus down: corporate ordering is closed. Call him if you change your mind.
Chinese: 你拒绝了撒该，巨企的订货暂不开放。打他的电话回心转意。

English: Requires a {0} basic membership ({1}₵ a week). Sign up on the Corporate Terms page.
Chinese: 需要{0}的基础会员（{1}₵ 一周），在“巨企合约”页开通。

English: {0}'s ordering service isn't active. Subscribe on the Corporate Terms page ({1}₵).
Chinese: {0}的订购服务未开通或已到期，请在“巨企合约”页开通（{1}₵）。

English: Zacchaeus's penalty: company services are suspended.
Chinese: 撒该的惩罚：公司服务暂停。

English: {0}'s ordering service expires tomorrow. Renewal is {1}₵.
Corporate Malice is off: the Merchant Union and the Resistance are the Spacer Alliance again, and subscriptions, vouchers, support points and Zacchaeus's accounts are cleared.
Chinese: 恶意巨企模式已关闭：商人联合和反抗军并回星际客联盟，订阅、代金券、助力点、撒该的账都清掉了。

English: {0}'s ordering service was renewed automatically for {1}₵.
Subscription fees are waived. No activation or renewal is needed; goods are charged normally.
Chinese: 已获免订阅费权益，无需开通或续费。商品货款照常结算。

English: Lapsed over a week: reactivation fee applies.
Chinese: 断供超过一周，再续要加复通费。

English: Not a member. Only members can use Solana's services.
Chinese: 未开通。会员才能使用索拉纳的服务。

English: Not subscribed. Subscribe to order by phone.
Chinese: 未开通。开通后才能电话订货。

English: Become a basic member ({0}₵ a week)
Each renewal covers 7 days, at most one week ahead; you get a reminder the day before. Auto-renew only charges if you can still pay rent afterwards.
Chinese: 续费每次管 7 天，最多提前续一周，到期前一天提醒。自动续费只在扣完后还够交房租时才扣。

English: Signed-tier goods need no application. Weekly limits: {0} / {1} / {2} per tier.
Earn 1₵ in vouchers per {0}₵ paid in cash on each purchase. Vouchers are used first and only at {1}.
Chinese: 在{0}每笔实付现金每满 {1}₵ 返 1₵ 代金券。代金券只在该公司使用，付款时优先抵扣。

English: Odin has been arrested. The Resistance has gone dark: orders and the fence network are suspended.
Chinese: 奥丁被捕了。反抗军断了线：订货、地下销赃网络都停了。

English: The Resistance's number ({0}) is now in the notebook by the phone.
Chinese: 反抗军的电话（{0}）记在了电话旁的记事簿上。

English: You joined the corporations; the Resistance wants nothing to do with you.
Chinese: 你加入了巨企，反抗军不再和你来往。

English: The Resistance has gone dark: Odin was arrested.
Chinese: 反抗军断线了：奥丁被捕。

English: The Resistance no longer sends you underground buyers.
Chinese: 反抗军不再给你安排地下买家。

English: I take anything, cash. Just make sure it checks out.
Chinese: 什么都收，现钱。货得经得起查。

English: The underground buyer caught the fraud and called off the deal. Support points -{0}, Resistance reputation -5.
Chinese: 地下买家识破了造假，终止交易。助力点 -{0}，反抗军声望 -5。

English: Word from the Mentor: he'll speak to the corporations on your behalf.
Chinese: 导师来了消息：他会替你去和那几家巨企谈。

English: The Lower Levels have named you their representative: all customers carry 50% more money.
Chinese: 下层区的人联名推你做了代表：所有顾客带的钱 +50%。

English: Where is the gift you called about? Hand it over.
Chinese: 电话里说的礼物呢？交给我。

English: You've helped us a lot. I need one more favor.
Chinese: 你帮了我们不少。我想请你再帮一个忙。

English: Get us a bottle of poison. If you can't, Dream Dust and Phanta Pills worth {0}₵ will do.
Chinese: 弄一瓶毒药给我们。弄不到的话，价值 {0}₵ 的梦尘和芬太片也行。

English: When it's ready, call us and I'll send someone.
Chinese: 准备好了就打我们的电话，我会叫人来取。

English: We need explosives. Meridian's heavy firepower would do in a pinch.
Chinese: 我们需要一批炸药，子午线的重火力也勉强可以。

English: I know you have connections at Meridian, so they can be bought: {0}₵ if you're on good terms, {1}₵ otherwise. They'll send a bomb, and I'll buy it.
Chinese: 子午线那边我知道你有关系可以打点：合作关系够的话 {0}₵，不然 {1}₵，他们会送一颗炸弹过来，我来买。

English: Otherwise, sell {0}₵ worth of weapons through the underground buyer.
Chinese: 不然的话，通过地下买家卖出价值 {0}₵ 的武器。

English: Meridian's package arrived? Hand it over.
Same as always: weapons and medical supplies, as much as you've got.
Chinese: 老规矩：武器和医疗品，有多少收多少。

English: Too many wounded since the great crackdown. Medical supplies, as much as you've got.
Chinese: 大清缴以后伤员太多了。医疗品，有多少收多少。

English: You turned them down. I heard.
Chinese: 你拒绝了他们。我听说了。

English: In three days, we take out the corporations' agent station in the Lower Levels.
Chinese: 三天后，我们去拔掉巨企在下层区的代理人站点。

English: Odin sent me to pick something up.
Nothing needs picking up right now.
Odin got what he needed. +{0} support points.
Chinese: 奥丁收到了东西。反抗军助力点 +{0}。

English: Odin: “Thanks. Weapon prices might go up soon. Stock up.”
Chinese: 奥丁：“谢了。之后武器可能会涨价，囤点货吧。”
革命军突袭治安部武器库

English: Revolutionaries struck a Security armory. Weapons are scarce station-wide and prices are up.
Chinese: 革命军袭击了治安部的一座武器库。站内武器紧缺，价格上涨。

English: Odin sent a crate of Meridian guns, taken off Security officers during the crackdown.
Chinese: 奥丁送来一箱子午线的枪：清缴的时候那些治安部身上搜出来的。

English: Inventory could not be checked. You have not been charged.
Chinese: 暂时无法检查库存，尚未扣款。

English: The mission bomb is still in storage.
Chinese: 库存里还有任务炸弹，无需补订。

English: The save changed; booking stopped before payment.
Chinese: 存档已变化，预约已停止，尚未扣款。

English: The save changed; booking stopped before payment.
Chinese: 存档已变化，预约已停止，尚未扣款。

English: The save changed; the old booking was stopped.
Chinese: 存档已变化，已停止旧预约。

English: The bomb from Meridian has been delivered.
Chinese: 子午线送来的炸弹已入库。

English: Explosives Meridian sent on the quiet. Odin will come for it.
Chinese: 子午线私下送来的炸药。奥丁会来买。
巨企协助治安部清缴反抗军

English: The corporations are backing a Security crackdown on the Resistance: heavy losses for the rebels, while Security gets a flood of supplies. Thanks to graft, plenty of weapons are leaking onto the market.
Chinese: 巨企协助治安部清缴反抗军：反抗军损失惨重，同时治安部得到大量补给。贪腐之下，大量武器流入市场。

English: Surplus from the crackdown. Cheap, if you want it.
Chinese: 清缴“多出来”的货。你要的话便宜给你。

English: Realizing the Lower Levels are slipping out of their grip, the corporations are placating them: all orders 10% off, no more subscription fees.
Chinese: 巨企意识到下层脱离掌控开始安抚下层区：所有订货九折，不再收订阅费。

English: Joint District Administration officer Zacchaeus Thorne was killed in an attack in the Lower Levels. Security has sealed the area; weapon prices are up.
Chinese: 联合站区管理处专员撒该·索恩在下层区遇袭身亡。治安部封锁了现场，武器价格上涨。

English: Odin has been rescued. The Resistance is back in touch.
Chinese: 奥丁被救出来了。反抗军恢复了联系。
革命军突袭治安部武器库
巨企协助治安部清缴反抗军

English: CorpPresence: containers still hold items. Free inventory space and retry before uninstalling.
Chinese: 公司增强：有未清空的容器，请腾出库存空间后重试，暂不要卸载。

English: CorpPresence: cleaned up ({0} phone numbers, {1} items). You can uninstall after this save.
Chinese: 公司增强：已清理（电话 {0} 个，物品 {1} 件），存档后即可卸载。

English: Here's the list. See if anything looks useful.
Chinese: 目录发给你了，看看有没有用得上的。

English: Of course. Opening our service catalog now.
Chinese: 好的，这就为您打开服务目录。

English: All right. Call me if you need anything.
All chapters: Malice mode on, envoy not gone; checked at opening.
Chinese: 共同前提：恶意模式开启，撒该未离场；开店时检查。

English: All chapters: Malice mode on; Odin met, not arrested or cut off; checked at opening. Support thresholds use lifetime earned points, not your current balance.
Chinese: 共同前提：恶意模式开启，已认识奥丁，未被捕且未断线；开店时检查。助力点门槛按累计获得计算，不是当前余额。

English: This company has no independent chapters.
• Main progress at least chapter {0}; this chapter not completed.
Chinese: • 主线进度达到第 {0} 章；本章尚未完成。

English: • Hold at least {0} qualifying item(s) in the shop; no cash gate for this chapter.
Chinese: • 店内持有符合收购要求的物品 ≥ {0} 件；本章不检查现金门槛。

English: Checked at closing for the next day. The planned visit must be at least {0} day(s) after this character's last story (current setting). Existing story bookings are handled first; main stories take priority over side stories. Characters are checked independently.
Chinese: 关店时检索，满足后预约次日。按预计来访日计算，距该人物上次剧情至少 {0} 天（当前设置）。已有剧情预约先完成，主线优先于支线；不同人物独立判断。

English: This guide does not complete tasks, grant items, or change your save.
Chinese: 这是触发条件说明，不会替你完成任务、补发物品或改变存档。

English: highest of Black Market/Revolution/Lower Levels (Black Market only in Malice mode)
Chinese: 黑市/革命军/下层区三者最高值（恶意模式仅黑市）

English: • Water Merchant start, or vanilla water trading unlocked. Canning is not a prerequisite.
Chinese: • 净水商开局，或已解锁原版水商功能。无需先完成罐装支线。

English:
• Davre cooperation ≥ 60.
• Rancher start, or RETIRED_RANCHER unlocked.
• The chapter 3 water side story is not required. If declined or payment fails, sign up later on the Canning Equipment phone page.
Chinese:
• 达夫雷合作度 ≥ 60。
• 养鼠开局，或解锁 RETIRED_RANCHER（养鼠相关升级）。
• 不要求先完成第3章净水支线。交谈后拒绝或现金不足，可在电话“罐装设备”页补办。

English: • Item: black_injector; counted by item identifier.
Chinese: • 物品：突触注射器 black_injector；按物品标识计数。

English:
• Carmicheal has recorded the creature grant (CreatureGiven).
• Currently hold a living creature at Adult stage or above. Main progress must have reached chapter 5.
Chinese:
• 卡迈克尔已记录发放三叶蜥（CreatureGiven）。
• 当前持有活着的成年或更高阶段三叶蜥。主线需先达到第5章。

English:
• Carmicheal blood-drawing license granted (Licensed).
• Recorded blood drawn (BloodDrawn) > 0.
Chinese:
• 已获卡迈克尔银血采血许可（Licensed）。
• 累计采血记录 BloodDrawn > 0。

English:
• Farmer start, or RETIRED_FARMER unlocked.
• Chapters 6–8 require main chapter 3, not chapter 5.
Chinese:
• 水培开局，或解锁 RETIRED_FARMER（水培相关升级）。
• 第6～8章只要求主线达到第3章，不必等主线第5章。

English:
• Rolling craft stage 1 completed (CraftDone(1)).
• Loose cigarettes sold ≥ 10 (LooseSold). The cash gate uses the current bribe fee.
Chinese:
• 已完成卷烟工艺第一阶段（CraftDone(1)）。
• 已累计售出散烟 ≥ 10（LooseSold）。现金门槛使用当前打点费用。

• 已完成打点（Bribed）。
• 已累计制作烟包 ≥ 6（PacksMade）。

English: • Meridian cooperation ≥ 60. The cash gate uses the current forge equipment fee.
Chinese: • 子午线合作度 ≥ 60。现金门槛使用当前锻造设备手续费。

Chinese: • 需2件可收购奢侈品；排除索拉纳拒收名单：护肤霜、神经活性香水、费洛蒙香水及本模组面膜、蜡烛（含点燃）、精华。

English:
Chapter 1: Aid

Malice mode on; envoy not gone; aid not handled.
First cash >3000 records the day. Booking requires cash <2500 later, or four days since that record.
Both Pastel and Carmicheal must be active with their business cards granted.
Acceptance requires both subscriptions for 21 days; a lapse creates five weekly payments of 800. Checked at opening, including pending bookings.
Chinese:
第1章：扶持金

恶意模式开启；撒该未离场、扶持金尚未处理。
现金首次 >3000 后记下日期；此后现金 <2500，或距该日期满4天，才会预约。
同时必须拿到帕斯泰尔和卡迈克尔两家联系方式（公司启用且已发名片）。
接受后需连续订阅两家公司21天；断订转为每周800、共5周的还款。开店时检查；待排队的旧预约也检查联系方式。

English:
Chapter 2: Service fee and gift

Aid completed or declined; chapter 2 not handled; cash >6000.
Pay the service fee, accept the gift, or refuse.
The gift has a 14-day deadline. Only Odin specifically booked from the Resistance phone Tasks page can take it. Ordinary/story Odin and fences cannot. He arrives next day; do not book on the deadline itself. Arrest, cutoff and blacklist block delivery.
Chinese:
第2章：服务费与礼物

第1章状态为扶持金完成或拒绝；本章未处理；现金 >6000。
可支付服务费、接受礼物或拒绝。
礼物期限14天，只能交给从反抗军电话“任务”页专门预约来的奥丁；普通奥丁、其他剧情奥丁及地下买家不能代收。预约次日到达，截止日当天不可再预约次日；被捕、断线或黑名单时不能交付。

English:
Chapter 3: Join the corporations

Chapter 2 paid, gift delivered, or channel-fee period ended.
Shop property purchased (IsPropertyPaid); chapter 3 not handled.
Booked at opening. Joining and refusing lead to different routes; joining affects Resistance contact.
Chinese:
第3章：加入巨企

第2章已付费、礼物已交付，或渠道费阶段已结束。
已经买下店铺产权（IsPropertyPaid）；本章尚未处理。
开店时预约。加入和拒绝会进入不同后续分支；加入会影响反抗军联系。

English:
Chapter 4: Mentor's message and coins

Corporations joined; chapter 4 not handled; cash ≥20000.
Opening records the message; call the Merchant Union to continue.
On the silent route, while not an agent, Pastel, Solana, Carmicheal, Meridian and Davre each send their unclaimed Fate Coin at cooperation ≥100.
Chinese:
第4章：导师来信与硬币

已经加入巨企；本章未处理；现金 ≥20000。
开店时登记导师来信，需回拨商人联合电话继续。
进入沉默分支后，未成为代理人时，帕斯泰尔、索拉纳、卡迈克尔、子午线、达夫雷各自合作度 ≥100，会分别预约尚未领取的命运硬币。

English:
Resistance chapter 1

Malice mode on; Odin met, not arrested or cut off. A Regular/Cooldown vanilla Resistance phone records the introduction and unlocks this mod's phone.
No completed/active Resistance chapter; total support points earned ≥50.
Booked at opening. Deliver poison, or 100 worth of Dream Dust/Phanta Pills.
Chinese:
反抗军第1章

恶意模式开启，已认识奥丁，未被捕且未断线。原版反抗军电话为正常或冷却状态后会登记认识并开放本模组反抗军电话。
尚无已完成/进行中的反抗军章节，累计获得助力点 ≥50。
开店时预约；任务交一瓶毒药，或累计价值100的梦尘/芬太片。

English:
Resistance chapter 2

Chapter 1 completed, no active chapter, total support points earned ≥300.
Bribe Meridian and sell its bomb to the chapter's Odin buyer, or sell 1000 worth of weapons through the underground buyer.
This bomb is distinct from Zacchaeus's gift; they are not interchangeable.
Chinese:
反抗军第2章

第1章完成，当前没有进行中章节，累计获得助力点 ≥300。
可打点子午线取得炸弹再交给任务买家奥丁，或通过地下买家累计售出价值1000的武器。
此章的子午线炸弹与撒该的礼物是两种不同任务物品，不能混交。

English:
Resistance chapter 3

Chapter 2 completed, no active chapter, total support points earned ≥500.
Starts at opening. Sell 1200 worth of medical supplies to the scheduled Odin buyer.
Odin must still be met, not arrested and not cut off.
Chinese:
反抗军第3章

第2章完成，当前没有进行中章节，累计获得助力点 ≥500。
开店时启动；奥丁按任务周期来收医疗品，累计售出金额达到1200完成。
仍要求已认识奥丁、未被捕、未断线。

English:
Resistance chapter 4

Chapter 3 completed, no active chapter, invitation not yet recorded; corporations refused in envoy chapter 3.
After invitation, call Odin from the Tasks page. After joining, sell 3000 worth of weapons/medical supplies to the quest buyer to book the raid; subsequent progression follows its scheduled day.
Chinese:
反抗军第4章

第3章完成，当前没有进行中章节，尚未记录加入邀请；撒该第3章已选择拒绝巨企。
邀请后可从反抗军任务页呼叫奥丁。加入后，向任务奥丁累计售出武器/医疗品达到3000，会安排突袭剧情，再按剧情日期推进。

English:
Resistance chapter 5

Chapter 4 completed, chapter 5 not started, cash ≥16000; Odin still met, not arrested and not cut off.
After activation, Pastel, Solana, Carmicheal, Meridian and Davre each book their unclaimed Fate Coin at cooperation ≥100.
All five coins must be recorded as received to complete the representative qualification.
Chinese:
反抗军第5章

第4章完成，第5章尚未启动，现金 ≥16000；仍需奥丁已认识、未被捕、未断线。
启动后，帕斯泰尔、索拉纳、卡迈克尔、子午线、达夫雷各自合作度 ≥100，分别安排未领取的命运硬币。
五家公司硬币都登记领取后，才完成最终代表资格。

Chinese: 3 营养果糊 + 1 杂肉糜 → 4 罐“泥炭”

Chinese: 2 精肉糜 + 1 营养果糊 → 1 罐鲜肉罐头

Chinese: 本次载入后尚未进行夜间结算。

Chinese: 鲜肉档需要 2 份精肉糜和 1 份营养果糊。

Chinese: 合成档需要 1 份杂肉糜和 3 份营养果糊。

English: Stopped: the power source cannot supply this cycle.
Chinese: 未加工：电源无法提供本次所需电量。

English: Output creation, placement or initial power draw failed; this batch's inputs were kept.
Chinese: 成品创建、放置或首次扣电失败；本批原料已保留。
加工异常，请查看游戏日志：

English: The tray cannot fit all {0} items from this batch.
Chinese: 成品槽放不下这批的 {0} 件成品。

English: 4 fish mince + 100 mL of Basewater or better → 1 crab stick. Requires reusable printer plastic.
Chinese: 4 份鱼肉糜 + 100 毫升基础水或更高档的水 → 1 份风味蟹肉棒。需放入可复用的 3D 打印耗材。

English: 1 dead, whole adolescent common tilapia + 100 mL of Basewater or better → 1 can of fish.
Chinese: 1 条已宰杀、未切片的亚成年普通罗非鱼 + 100 毫升基础水或更高档的水 → 1 罐鱼罐头。

English: 1 nutrifruit paste → 1 Galaxy Blend (no water or printer plastic)
Chinese: 1 份营养果糊 → 1 份繁星果糊（无需水或耗材）

English: Load one dead, whole adolescent common tilapia.
Chinese: 需要一条已宰杀、未切片的亚成年普通罗非鱼。

English: Load 4 fish mince and 1 printer plastic.
Chinese: 需要 4 份鱼肉糜和 1 个 3D 打印耗材。

English: Load a container with at least 100 mL of water.
Chinese: 需要一个装有至少 100 毫升水的容器。
水质须为基础水或更高档。

English: First batch ready for overnight production or turbo boost.
Chinese: 首批条件满足，可过夜生产或使用充能器。

English: Water or power draw failed. No batch was sealed.
Chinese: 扣水或供电失败，本批未封装。

English: Power draw failed. No batch was sealed.
Not enough water in the tank: need {0} ml
Chinese: 水箱里的水不够，要 {0} 毫升

English: {0} capacity upgraded to level {1}: {2} more row(s) in each expandable storage grid
Chinese: {0}容量升到 {1} 级：可扩容的仓储格各多 {2} 行

English: {0} power saver installed: 1 less charge per run
Capacity: level {0}/{1}. Drag metal ingots onto it to upgrade ({2}/{3} for this level, any purity)
Chinese: 容量：{0}/{1} 级，拖金属锭上来升级（这级 {2}/{3} 块，纯度不限）

English: Power saver: installed, 1 less charge per run
Chinese: 省电：已装，每次加工少耗 1 电

English: Power saver: drag electronic components onto it ({0}/{1}) for 1 less charge per run
Chinese: 省电：拖电子元件上来安装（{0}/{1} 个），每次加工少耗 1 电

English: Ready. First daily draw: no injury; second: minor wound; third: major wound.
Chinese: 可以采血。每日第一次无伤，第二次轻伤，第三次重伤。
只能使用自己的采血机。

English: Cannot draw blood while seriously wounded.
Blood drawn: received 1 ordinary blood bag.
Chinese: 采血完成，获得1袋普通血。

English: At least {0:0.##} mL of actual base oil is needed; purity is not checked.
Chinese: 至少需要{0:0.##}mL实际基底油成分；不检查纯度。

English: Ingredients ready. Wait overnight or turbo boost.
Chinese: 原料合格，等待过夜或加速加工。

English: Not enough ingredients for the selected recipe.
This batch needs {0} base oil materials.
Chinese: 当前配方需要{0}份基底油材料。

English: Output is full or the product directory is unavailable.
Chinese: 成品空间不足或成品目录暂不可用。

Chinese: 收获物中含有可提取基底油的芳香花浆。
产生 {0:0.#} mL 含油花浆。

English: No room in the shop. Make some space before drawing blood.
Chinese: 店里放不下了，先腾点地方再采血。

English: A numbered specimen from a Carmicheal lab. Its carapace splits into three lobes, silver light leaking from the seams.
Chinese: 卡迈克尔实验室的编号标本。背甲分成三节，甲缝里透着银光。

English:
You inject the Rejuvenation Serum. (3/3)
The symptoms of Sentinel Collapse Syndrome are gone. You'll never need Immunivax again.
Chinese:
你注射了回春药剂。（3/3）
哨兵崩溃综合征的症状消失了。你再也不需要免疫宁了。

English:
You inject the Rejuvenation Serum. (2/3)
You can barely feel the symptoms. This shot also counts as Immunivax.
Chinese:
你注射了回春药剂。（2/3）
症状几乎感觉不到了。这一针也当作打过免疫宁。

English:
You inject the Rejuvenation Serum. (1/3)
The symptoms ease. This shot also counts as Immunivax.
Chinese:
你注射了回春药剂。（1/3）
症状减轻了。这一针也当作打过免疫宁。

English: There's a parcel at the door with no sender.
Chinese: 门口放着一只没有寄件人的包裹。
感谢指令，通过，向你致谢。

English: The active sprite stays visible until the output tray is emptied.
Chinese: 成品槽有成品时显示运行图，取空后恢复静态图。

English: CorpPresence failed to initialize and attempted to roll back this startup. Temporarily disable CorpPresence and report this session's game log. Keep your original save.
Chinese: 公司增强初始化失败，已尝试撤销本次加载。请暂时禁用公司增强，并附上本次游戏日志报告问题；请保留原存档。
每天最多几位公司人物

English: Extra visitors are pushed to the next day: story first, then whoever has waited longest. Paid foot traffic, VIPs and lab buyers don't count.
Chinese: 超出的人顺延到第二天：剧情优先，其次是最久没来的。花钱请来的客流、贵宾、实验室访客不算在内。

English: When on, each item ordered by phone has a weekly limit, tiered by its base value:
Chinese: 打开后，各公司电话订货的每样货每周限量，按一份的基础价值分阶：

English: Exclusives like Hemingway Limited Edition and the Immunivax case keep their own limits either way.
Chinese: 海明威限量包装、免疫宁整箱这些独家货不管开不开都按原来的限量。

English: When on, vanilla market events (a type of item going up or down in price) also change phone order prices: the order price rises or falls by as much as the event moves that type of item, matching how the shop values it.
Chinese: 打开后，原版市场事件（某类物品涨价、降价）也会影响电话订货的单价：事件让这类物品涨多少、跌多少，订货价就跟着涨跌多少，和店里同类物品的估价一致。

English:
You pay the price at the time of ordering; nothing is refunded when the event ends. The Spacer grab box and fixed-price machines are not affected.
Off: order prices ignore events (the old behaviour).
Chinese:
下单时按当时的价格结算，之后事件结束也不退差价。星际客改装盲盒、各公司的固定价设备不受影响。
关闭：订货价不看事件（以前的做法）。

English:
Phone order price = item value × this (default 1.1). Each higher cooperation tier is 0.05 cheaper: Signed ×1.1, Regular ×1.05, Partner ×1.0 (at the default).
Meridian's high-end attachments and the Leviathan use this multiplier too (regardless of tier). The Spacer grab box is a fixed 500₵. The Hemingway Label Stamp is a fixed 400₵.
Chinese:
电话订货的价格 = 物品价值 × 这个倍数（默认 1.1）。合作档位越高每档便宜 0.05：签约 ×1.1、长期客户 ×1.05、合作伙伴 ×1.0（按默认值）。
子午线高端配件、利维坦也按这个倍数（不看档位）。星际客改装盲盒固定 500₵，海明威标签戳固定 400₵。

English:
The most a company character will spend when buying from you (the six characters and the Solana lab buyer).
Dynamic: 800 + random 0–250 + the current day, based on the richest vanilla customers (750–1000 + day).
How much Solana's VIPs bring depends on “Service strength”.
Chinese:
公司人物来收货时最多花多少信用点（六位人物、索拉纳采购员）。
动态：800 + 随机 0～250 + 当前天数，参照原版最有钱的顾客（750～1000 + 天数）。
索拉纳贵宾带多少钱看“服务强度”。

标准：现在的数值。
原版：按原版数值校准——
· 索拉纳贵宾带 800 + 随机 0～250 + 天数（标准是 3000～5000）；原版最有钱的顾客带 750～1000 + 天数；
· 实验室采购员收单上的货一律 1.5 倍（标准：2 倍，蓝血 3 倍）；原版涨价事件最常见 +50%；
· 体力增强剂累计最多 +2 次拾荒（标准：每针 +1，不封顶）；原版开局特长“熟练拾荒者”是 +2；
· 罗森批发八折（标准：七折）；原版供货商八折。

标准：现在的数值。
原版：日常收货不加价，特殊需求最多 1.5 倍（原版顾客按成交价付钱，涨价事件最常见 +50%）——
· 米洛收海明威假烟 2 倍 → 1.5 倍；
· 瑟琳日常收货 1.2 倍 → 1 倍，收蓝血 3 倍 → 1.5 倍；
· 伊莎收赛纳普斯 1.5 倍、瑟琳章节里收奢侈品 1.3 倍、多琳收海德拉 400₵ 不变；伊莎、罗森日常收货本来就不加价。

English:
When on: corporate phone orders need a weekly subscription, services cost more, and tier goods must be unlocked by paid application; the Spacer Alliance splits into the Merchant Union and the Resistance; the corporate envoy Zacchaeus comes calling.
Starting a new save is recommended. Turned on mid-game: cooperation tiers are kept, but unlocked goods must be applied for again. Turned off mid-game (from the next day's opening): both sides merge back into the Spacer Alliance, and subscriptions, vouchers, support points and Zacchaeus's accounts are cleared.
Chinese:
打开后：巨企的订货要按周订阅，服务全面涨价，合作档位的货要花钱申请解锁；星际客联盟拆成商人联合和反抗军；巨企使者撒该会找上门。
建议从新档开始。中途打开：合作档位保留，已解锁的货要重新申请。中途关闭（第二天开店生效）：两边并回星际客联盟，订阅、代金券、助力点、撒该的账全部清空。

English: On: each company's cooperation (Trust for the Spacer Alliance) rises by at most
Chinese: 打开：每家公司的合作度（星际客联盟叫信任度）每天最多涨

English: per day; the excess is lost.
Trades, orders, services and reputation gains all count; story rewards and story minimums are not capped.
Chinese: 买卖、订货、服务、声望上涨都算在内；剧情推进的奖励和剧情保底不受限制。
合作度：每多少信用点涨 1 点

English:
Trading with company people, phone orders (including the Leviathan), the pastel dealer fee and Meridian refurbishment fees give 1 cooperation point per this many credits (default 400); selling the company's products counts at 3x that (default 1 point per 1200₵).
Vanilla faction reputation rises 1 point per 400₵. Story rewards and the Spacer reputation conversion are not affected.
Chinese:
和公司的人买卖、电话订货（含利维坦）、帕斯泰尔加盟费、子午线翻新费，每这么多信用点涨 1 点合作度（默认 400）；卖出本公司产品按 3 倍算（默认每 1200₵ 涨 1 点）。
原版势力声望是每 400₵ 涨 1 点。剧情奖励和星际客的声望折算不受影响。

English: How much to enlarge the service window opened from company phone calls. 1 = the old size. Shrinks automatically if it doesn't fit the screen.
Chinese: 公司电话打开的服务界面放大几倍。1 = 以前的大小。屏幕放不下时会自动缩小到刚好放得下。

English:
Turn on when you want to uninstall, together with “Confirm cleanup” below. With both on, save once (sleep or save manually):
· company phone numbers are removed from the phone book and the save;
· every item from this mod is deleted (cards, new items, Rosen's guns, the Leviathan, etc.).
Then you can uninstall. Keep it off if you're not uninstalling.
Chinese:
要卸载本模组时打开，并同时勾选下面的“确认清理”。两项都打开后存一次档（睡觉或手动存档）：
· 公司电话从电话簿和存档里移除；
· 本模组的物品全部删除（名片、新物品、罗森的手作枪、利维坦等）。
存完档就可以卸载。不卸载的话请保持关闭。
确认清理（会删除本模组的物品）

English: Only takes effect together with “Clean up before uninstalling”. Deleted items cannot be restored.
Chinese: 和“卸载前清理”一起打开才会生效。删除的物品无法恢复。

English: How many weeks until weekly order limits and Davre's Leviathan quota refill. 1 = every week (the original behavior).
Chinese: 每周限量的货、达夫雷利维坦的配额，多少周补一次货。1 = 每周（原来的做法）。

English:
Which set of company portraits to use.
New, smooth: three tiers, smooth HD images from 1080p up.
New, pixel: pixel art; 4K image at 4K, 2K image otherwise.
HD: the original HD portraits; 4K image at 4K, 2K image otherwise (Zacchaeus uses New, smooth).
All use sharper images at higher resolutions; at 1080p and above the game's low-resolution pass is skipped (changes the game's pixel-perfect camera).
Chinese:
选公司人物用哪一套立绘。
平滑新版立绘：分三档，1080p 起是平滑的高清图。
像素化新版立绘：像素画，4K 用 4K 图，其余都用 2K 图。
高清立绘：原来的高清立绘，4K 用 4K 图，其余都用 2K 图（撒该没有这一套，用平滑新版）。
都按屏幕分辨率用不同清晰度的图；1080p 及以上会关掉游戏的低分辨率中转（会改游戏的像素完美相机）。

English: Minimum days before the next daily visit. Takes effect from the next visit.
Chinese: 这次日常来访之后，最少隔几天再来。改了从下一次来访起生效。

English: Maximum days before the next visit; picked at random between min and max. If lower than min, min is used.
Chinese: 最多隔几天再来，在最少和最多之间随机。比最少还小时按最少算。

English: Minimum days between story chapters (1 = the next day once conditions are met, the original behavior).
Chinese: 上一章之后，至少隔几天下一章才来（1 = 条件够了第二天就来，原来的做法）。
